title: renderThemeControl() shell markup for the standalone three-state theme toggle
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): renders the Light|Dark|Auto group (`role="group"`, three `<button>`s with `aria-pressed` and `data-rcf-theme="light|dark|auto"`) stamped with `[data-rcf-theme-control]`. The buttons start with `aria-pressed="false"`; `page-init.js` boots them from the resolved theme choice (query -> stored -> auto) per ADR-4137. Keyboard-operable (`<button type="button">`), screen-reader-labelled (`aria-label` + `title`), server-rendered. Also keeps the existing `renderSearchButton()` and `renderLookupModal()` exports.
